name: @stubbedev/sentry-mcp
description: MCP server for self-hosted Sentry (Go, distributed as a prebuilt binary)

scripts.bundle: go build -o sentry-mcp . && packaging/mcpb/pack.sh ./sentry-mcp $(case $(uname -s) in Darwin) echo darwin;; MINGW*|MSYS*) echo win32;; *) echo linux;; esac) dist/sentry-mcp.mcpb
scripts.preversion: go vet ./... && npm run test && npm run smoke
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push origin HEAD --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin HEAD --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin HEAD --follow-tags
